notes.title: Hero.EXE Demo Overhaul Update 0.0.7
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37627393/50f38313c85bc9a4155959499a413633f4550cc3.png

Hey Pilots! Long time no see-- here's a nice juicy update to our Demo, complete with a massive Art & Animation overhaul! 

Changelog:

+ Character Art Overhaul (incorporating Spine2D animation system)
+ Combat Stage Art Overhaul
+ Combat Projectile VFX Art Overhaul
+ New Cards added to the Pool
+ New Enemy Variants added
+ Partial Controller Support added (Combat-Only currently, still undergoing refinement)
+ Remappable Controls added to Options
+ Further SFX backend system improvements
+ Improvements and adjustments to VN Scenes
+ Improvements and adjustments to SFX
+ Various minor Bugfixes and Gameplay feel refinements
- Further reduced frequency of Random Encounters

Known issues:


- Phantom Tile highlights can occasionally be triggered by Health Volcano and Charge Attack
- Grenade projectiles can occasionally get stuck spinning
- Lovely.ldy enemy will occasionally not finish her attack animation


To see our Development Progress, check out our latest Kickstarter Update Post: 
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/heroexegame/heroexe/posts/3736557

And if you'd like to give us your feedback, or encounter any bugs you'd like to report, come find us on our Community Discord-- let's chat! http://discord.gg/BHk2fJ6

EPILEPSY WARNING: Post-Credits scene has some flashing!

notes.title: Hero.EXE Demo Update 0.0.5 and Kickstarter Announcement!
notes.notes:

Attention Pilots! The Grid needs you!

Hero.EXE is now live on Kickstarter! We have a ton of exclusive physical rewards for all of our amazing fans!  Pledge early to get access to the Early Bird rewards! If you can’t pledge please like and share to help us reach our goal!

Link: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/heroexegame/heroexe

We also have some exciting updates for the demo coinciding with the launch of our Kickstarter campaign!

Changelog:
+ NEW DEMO BOSS

notes.title: Hero.EXE Demo Update 0.3 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Notes

VN character size adjusted
We adjusted the characters to be a bit smaller 

Charge attack adjusted
The Charge attack was not consistently firing. We've adjusted them

New credits video added
We added the new credits video at the end of the demo. We'll be adding the new VA lines soon. 

Broken tile time reduced by half
We got some feed back that the broken tiles lasted to long so we adjusted them to half their original time. 

Valentine talks less during combat
Valentine will now speak less during combat encounters. 

Added new VN illustrations
Added 2 new illustrations to the Meet the merchants scene.

Crack cards no longer crack the tile you are standing on
When using wave based crack cards the card would also crack the tile you are standing on. Now all projectiles start on the tile in front of you.

More SFX added
We added a few more sound effects to the game in various spots.
